interpretation.inputs: Each pair shares matches, RANSAC inliers, source/target KLT covariances and one Ceres initial pose
interpretation.feedback: Only the symmetric analytic baseline is fed back; other refinements are recorded only
interpretation.scope: Development windows selected from previous trajectory analysis; not held-out validation
interpretation.gt_scores: Epipolar geometry diagnostics assume static correct correspondences. They are not pixel endpoint truth or proof of covariance calibration
interpretation.nll: Gaussian residual-score change relative to nominal variance at the same specified pose; negative is better under that diagnostic model
interpretation.inverse_variance: Ratio evaluates the residual denominator at a common pose; it is not the full nonlinear optimizer influence or an information-gain measure
interpretation.timing: Diagnostic solves add overhead; capture timing is not a method speed benchmark
